title: Botswana - LONDA 2025
why: Q1-Q3: reported to say that in late 2025 the Act lacked a formal commencement date and had not come into use, with no public record of requests.

title: Botswana Country Factual Report
why: Q2-Q3: reported to describe implementation of the Act as weak, with no clear complaints venue or mechanism to compel release.

title: Govt works to establish location for Data Protection Body
why: Q2: reported to say the Information and Data Protection Commissioner had three contract officers with premises and staffing still being arranged; the Act names this body as overseer.
